description: Retrying a call (`booth.road`: `invoke booth.reserve("12A") retry 2 on Busy after 1s`). Without `on` it would retry the same, never `Unanswered`. Booth r1 answers Guest r2's first two calls `fail Busy`; each takes the retry branch to `Backoff`, whose 1s timer goes back to `Attempt`, which calls again with a new invoke id, `src` `booth.reserve` each time. The third call is answered `done`, and the Guest ends with the seat.
